rules.image: NEW one visual/audible dragon image in a20ft cube centered at a declared perceived anchor within120ft/LoE. A known generic dragon-shaped figure and a repeated nonlinguistic roar are appearance only,not actual dragon taxonomy,memories,messages or a statblock. Creation volume must be clear of actual solid matter and real bodies; no support is needed for a nonphysical image. It has no creature/object HP,AC,body,inventory,collision,cover,transport capacity,senses,independent turn or companion budget. Physical inspection can prove it false personally without destroying it. P156-APPARENT-01 grants only the new paid hidden-failure pathway; there is no Spectral Army attack/detonation rule.
rules.movement: NEW on an actual caster regular turn,spend one real Bonus Action to translate the image at most30ft along one declared3D route,with complete swept image volume clear of actual opaque solid matter and ending within120ft of the caster. Visual flight is not real flight/support. Passing through a real creature is nonphysical and supplies actual contradiction only to an observer who perceives that contact; it creates no damage or new fear admission. Known invalid movement rejects before BA; hidden obstruction stops at last legal image position,spends BA and grants no secret diagnostic/free remaining move. The image provides no scouting report. Caster moving beyond120ft or losing source-to-image LoE makes move/breath unavailable until legally restored; image persists at last position until source ends. No teleport of image on reacquisition.
rules.fear: NEW one finite initial audience: all real creatures,friend or foe,within30ft of the established image anchor by occupied-body interior,with actual LoE and usable sight perceiving the image at that instant. Each independently saves WIS versus original caster DC. Failure establishes image-sourced Frightened unless actual applicable fear/mental defense prevents it. No admission on later sight,entry,movement or resumption. Source-local operating gate: its Frightened expression is suspended while image is suppressed or not actually visually perceived by that recipient,so hidden image movement cannot become a location oracle. While operative use exact Frightened: disadvantage attacks/checks while source visible,and cannot willingly approach its current anchor. No forced flight,dropped items or lost full Action. Repeat WIS at every future actual regular END,including while temporarily unseen/suppressed; first success ends that record. Initial success protects only against this cast. Death/expiry/removal ends it. NEW for an owner-attached recipient,only the original real attached END may host the same save; if none exists,a six-second save-only checkpoint supplies it,never movement,Action,Reaction,recharge or death save. Exact original deadline never extends.
rules.breath: NEW after establishment,on a real caster regular turn spend one actual Action,at most once per original numbered-round opportunity,to emit a30ft right-circular cone with45degree half-angle from one declared mouth point on/in the image cube and one declared axis. Caster must actually perceive/locate its own image,be within120ft and have source-to-image LoE; each target needs actual mouth LoE and occupied-body INTERIOR intersection. All real creatures including allies/caster are eligible; no object damage or image target. Each makes WIS versus original spell DC; fail6d6psychic,success floor(shared6d6/2),then actual defenses. One shared6d6 is generated for each genuinely manifested activation,including an empty cone,as a NEW private data operation; no cast/RP/cadence/caster-hook duplication. No initial free breath—the creation Action is already spent. No breath while suppressed,source-ended or budget spent,no stored discharge after resumption. No generic elemental breath,ignition,normal-weapon hit or corpse effect.
rules.independentComponents: NEW psychic damage and failed-save fear are magical functions independent of believing the image. True Seeing or conclusive examination marks the image as personally identifiable false presentation; neither is antimagic,psychic immunity or a free fear success. Blind recipients are not initially admitted to visual fear but can be actual cone recipients. Fear-only immunity does not block psychic damage; psychic-only immunity does not remove an independently eligible fear relation. Exact Mind Blank classification follows common.defenses. No borrowed dragon defenses or ordinary creature restoration applies to an image.
rules.rootsAndEnding: NEW every actual paid breath activation consumes its Action/round opportunity before callbacks and makes a distinct caster-owned damage root for each actual recipient,all using that caster current unsuppressed Null state at creation. One shared pool is not one shared recipient root; pure transfer retains its root,never duplicate funding. Later activation re-evaluates then-current caster state. Image is not a dealer. One image per caster,concentration60elapsed seconds. Source ending erases image/fear/remaining activation permission without final breath. Suppression suspends presentation,movement,damage and operative fear while original ending-save/deadline bookkeeping continues. Restoring it gives no replay,free Action or new fear audience.
